sub_sector.value: Precast concrete products; safety barrier rental; precast licensing

manufacturing_type.detail: Manufactures individual precast units, including architectural cladding panels, traffic barriers, and utility buildings.

production_model.detail: Engineers standard and custom precast products to meet project specifications.

product_complexity.detail: Designs precast products to project specifications and develops proprietary systems such as the J-J Hooks safety barrier.

production_role.detail: Manufactures and installs finished precast products, rents safety barriers, and licenses proprietary systems to other precasters.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves building construction, transportation infrastructure, power utilities, and secured events.

notes: The evidence supports project-specific production but leaves stock production unverified.
